verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own review queue: transactions are processed through transaction monitoring, which produces cases and alerts. Analysts can prioritise, filter (by customer risk, stage, assignee, created date) and decide on those cases in the Mesh web app or via the API, with a per-case audit trail. The evidence does not show what context a case displays to the analyst, so the core 'full context in one view' promise is unproven. Missing for 10: documented display of customer history, risk signals and similar cases within the review view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of analyst review speed and consistency.
